key_insight: The model predicts Alzheimer’s disease progression over time while also estimating how uncertain each future diagnosis and biomarker forecast is.
clinical_relevance: This could help researchers and clinicians better anticipate likely disease trajectories and identify cases where the forecast is less reliable, especially around MCI-to-dementia transitions.
method: Temporal Fusion Transformer encoder with a CORAL ordinal output layer for ordered diagnosis prediction
Autoregressive Mixture Density Network to generate 5-year trajectories for diagnosis, CDR-SB, MMSE orientation, and hippocampal volume
Separate aleatoric and epistemic uncertainty using mixture variance plus a 5-member bootstrap ensemble
evidence_signal: On ADNI, the approach outperformed linear, recurrent, and transformer baselines for next-visit diagnosis prediction, produced near-nominal 90% interval coverage, and showed stronger epistemic uncertainty on OASIS-3.
watch_item: External performance and uncertainty calibration may vary across cohorts, so deployment would need careful validation before real-world use.
paper_title: Uncertainty-Aware Longitudinal Forecasting of Alzheimer's Disease Progression Using Deep Learning
